page_description_chirho: Your account and private workspace with Perffection.

signup_chirho.body_chirho: Choose a private username and password to start your website. Your draft stays private until you choose to publish it.

signin_chirho.body_chirho: Sign in with the username you chose and your current password to return to your workspace.

success_chirho.body_chirho: Now sign in with the username and password you just chose. There is no account number to copy.

unavailable_chirho.body_chirho: Please wait before trying again. If you already completed account creation, try signing in with the details you chose.

username_help_chirho: Use the same username each time you sign in. This is not your email address or your public website address.
new_password_help_chirho: Choose a long, unique password and save it in your password manager. Never send anyone your password.
challenge_help_chirho: Enter the answer to the question shown. This check can only be used once.
skip_chirho: Skip to account form or status
help_body_chirho: Save your username and password in your password manager. If you are unsure whether account creation finished, try signing in first; don't create another account to recover saved work.

too-many-requests-chirho.body_chirho: We can't accept another request right now. Wait before trying again.

request-malformed-chirho.body_chirho: We couldn't accept that form. Check your username and password requirements, then open a fresh form when you are ready.

registration-disabled-chirho.heading_chirho: New accounts aren't open here yet.
registration-disabled-chirho.body_chirho: If you already have an account, you can still sign in.

registration-token-required-chirho.body_chirho: This location isn't accepting open signup. If you already have an account, sign in instead.

registration-unavailable-chirho.heading_chirho: Account creation is unavailable right now.
registration-unavailable-chirho.body_chirho: Please wait before trying again. If account creation may have finished, try signing in with the details you chose first.

registration-cohort-full-chirho.heading_chirho: We're at capacity for new accounts.
registration-cohort-full-chirho.body_chirho: We can't open another account right now. Existing customers can still sign in.

human-check-required-chirho.body_chirho: Open a fresh signup form and answer the question before submitting it.

human-check-rejected-chirho.body_chirho: Open a fresh signup form and answer its question. Don't resend the previous form.

grant-unsupported-chirho.heading_chirho: Please use the current signup form.
grant-unsupported-chirho.body_chirho: That form isn't supported. Open a fresh signup form to continue.

credential-required-chirho.body_chirho: Choose a password on a fresh signup form before submitting it.

owner-registration-unsupported-chirho.heading_chirho: Please use the current signup form.
owner-registration-unsupported-chirho.body_chirho: That account request isn't supported here. Open a fresh signup form to continue.

human-check-unavailable-chirho.body_chirho: Please wait, then open a fresh signup form. No answer can be submitted without a check.

auth-rate-limited-chirho.body_chirho: Please wait about {wait_minutes_chirho} minutes, then try again. Use your current username and password when you return.

invalid-credential-chirho.body_chirho: Check your username and password, then try again. If you changed your password, use the new one.
